question: De los productos con stock bajo el punto de reorden, cual es el que mas ingreso genero en el semestre?

steps.purpose: products with stock below reorder point and their revenue
steps.sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(s.amount) AS total_revenue FROM sales s JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE i.stock < i.reorder_point AND s.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1
